description: This file contains multiple serializer and copier implementations for different array and memory types, notably for BitArray, byte[], ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, Memory<byte>, ArraySegment<byte>, and a custom PooledBuffer type. It includes registration attributes and methods for reading, writing, and copying these types, primarily used within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: BitArrayCodec
classes.description: Serializer for BitArray arrays, handling reading and writing of BitArray structures.

classes.name: BitArrayCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for BitArray that duplicates the object.

classes.name: ByteArrayCodec
classes.description: Serializer for byte[] arrays, including reading and writing methods.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryOfByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, handling serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: PooledBufferCopier
classes.description: Shallow copier for PooledBuffer instances, assuming immutability.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from the serialization stream, deserializing based on wire type.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a value to the serialization stream, handling reference lookups and wire protocol.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object, often by cloning arrays or memory spans.
